title: Preserve rival authority owners across transition-path naming read races
outcome: Transition recovery refuses a changed pre-read local context before re-preparing over a rival's authority owner, while preserving exact retained event custody.
acceptance: Capture transition selection/journal context before off-lock proof/learning windows and validate it before recovery can replace a rival authority owner; genuine same-context supersession remains bounded and recoverable.

A deterministic rival-selection-change plus real owner-supersession control covers both send-path and before-selection windows and asserts refusal preserves rival owner id/version, selection and immutable pending event without another producer write.
